hooks.name: Gesture from spec
hooks.description: When Kiro saves packages/gestures/specs/<name>.gesture.md, give Kiro a work order: write the detector, a property test for every 'Must NOT fire when' line, register it, run the tests.

hooks.name: Gesture tests on save
hooks.description: Runs the gesture tests whenever Kiro saves a file in packages/gestures/src, so a broken detector shows up at once.

action.command: pnpm exec vitest run packages/gestures --reporter=dot 2>&1 | tail -40
